frontmatter.name: agents-sdk
frontmatter.description: Build stateful AI agents on Cloudflare Workers. Use for Agents SDK state, RPC, WebSockets, schedules, workflows, queues, voice, MCP servers, or React chat clients.

frontmatter.name: audit-analysis
frontmatter.description: Audit empirical social-science analyses for data integrity, identification, inference, robustness, and claim validity. Use for experiments, panels, causal designs, or replication packages.

frontmatter.name: audit-package
frontmatter.description: Audit a software package for correctness defects and prepare an upstream-quality fix. Use for maintained libraries, dependencies, regression tests, and reproducible bug reports.

frontmatter.name: build-data
frontmatter.description: Turn raw or unfamiliar data into an analysis-ready file. Use for undocumented columns, sentinel codes, recodes, data dictionaries, join keys, row-count contracts, and merge audits.

frontmatter.name: cloudflare
frontmatter.description: Build or review Cloudflare applications and infrastructure. Use for Workers, Pages, storage, AI, networking, security, feature flags, Terraform, or Pulumi. Retrieve current docs first.

frontmatter.name: cloudflare-email-service
frontmatter.description: Build or review Cloudflare Email Sending and Email Routing. Use for transactional email, Workers bindings, REST APIs, deliverability, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, or Agents SDK email.

frontmatter.name: cloudflare-one
frontmatter.description: Design, configure, troubleshoot, or review Cloudflare One deployments. Use for Access, Gateway, WARP, Tunnel, WAN, DLP, CASB, device posture, identity, or Zero Trust migrations.

frontmatter.name: cloudflare-one-migrations
frontmatter.description: Plans migrations from Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Palo Alto, legacy VPN, SWG, or SASE stacks to Cloudflare One. Use for migration assessments, policy mapping, rollout plans, and parity/gap analysis.

frontmatter.name: design-analysis
frontmatter.description: Design an empirical study before estimation. Use to state estimands and assumptions, freeze analyses, choose inference and clustering, plan placebos, or structure a research repository.

frontmatter.name: durable-objects
frontmatter.description: Build or review Cloudflare Durable Objects. Use for stateful coordination, RPC, SQLite storage, alarms, WebSockets, Workers bindings, or Vitest tests. Retrieve current docs first.

frontmatter.name: empirical-problem-solving
frontmatter.description: Diagnose a broken empirical metric, model, experiment, or pipeline. Use to reproduce and shrink failures, enumerate rival causes, order tests, and stop on evidence.

frontmatter.name: ocr-error-triage
frontmatter.description: Diagnose and improve OCR or document extraction. Use to measure error without full ground truth, localize failures, test repairs out of sample, and gate regressions and cost.

frontmatter.name: on-writing
frontmatter.description: Edit prose for organization, clarity, voice, and AI-writing tells. Use for papers, documentation, memos, emails, reports, reviews, humanization, or matching an author's voice.
frontmatter.allowed-tools: - Read - Write - Edit - Grep - Glob - AskUserQuestion

frontmatter.name: release
frontmatter.description: Cut a package release, tag, or registry publication. Requires user-facing documentation review with on-writing, complete tests, and independent second-model review before release.

frontmatter.name: review-article
frontmatter.description: Review a quantitative empirical social-science paper. Use to assess experiments, difference-in-differences, RD, IV, natural experiments, inference, and causal claims.

frontmatter.name: sandbox-migrate-to-next
frontmatter.description: Port a Cloudflare Sandbox app from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to the @next SDK 1.0 preview. Use only for migrations, not stable maintenance or new @next applications.

frontmatter.name: sandbox-next
frontmatter.description: Build or change apps on @cloudflare/sandbox@next, the SDK 1.0 preview. Use for execution, runners, terminals, files, mounts, tunnels, lifecycle, or errors; not stable apps.

frontmatter.name: sandbox-stable
frontmatter.description: Build or change apps on stable @cloudflare/sandbox. Use for commands, sessions, files, ports, tunnels, terminals, production, or deprecated-API cleanup; not the @next preview.

frontmatter.name: todo
frontmatter.description: Read and write the user's Obsidian TaskNotes todo list. Use when asked to add, track, complete, or show tasks, preserving enough context for the task to be resumed later.

frontmatter.name: turnstile-spin
frontmatter.description: Set up Cloudflare Turnstile end to end. Use to add or fix CAPTCHA protection, create a widget, wire frontend and server-side siteverify, validate, and persist the skill.
frontmatter.references: - vanilla-html - nextjs-app - nextjs-pages - astro - sveltekit - hugo

frontmatter.name: visualize-evidence
frontmatter.description: Design or audit empirical figures, tables, and maps. Use for comparisons, uncertainty, units, captions, visual consistency, generated exhibits, or rendered-page quality assurance.

frontmatter.name: web-perf
frontmatter.description: Audit or optimize web performance with Chrome DevTools MCP. Use for Core Web Vitals, load speed, render blocking, network chains, layout shifts, caching, or accessibility.

frontmatter.name: workers-best-practices
frontmatter.description: Write or review Cloudflare Workers for production. Use for Worker code, Wrangler configuration, streaming, promises, global state, secrets, bindings, or observability.

frontmatter.name: wrangler
frontmatter.description: Use the Cloudflare Wrangler CLI for Workers, storage, AI, containers, queues, workflows, pipelines, secrets, and deployment. Load before running Wrangler commands.

frontmatter.name: write-empirical-paper
frontmatter.description: Coordinate revision of a quantitative empirical paper and repository. Use for analysis audits, prose, figures, tables, citations, compilation, rendered-page checks, and claim validation.
